text: Customer writes: 'The gateway keeps rejecting us. The request goes out with Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhY2N0LTk2NTEwMDIwIiwic2NvcGUiOiJyZWFkOnRpY2tldHMiLCJpYXQiOjE3ODcwMDAwMDB9.EIU4RgVDFULCoh9pf1V4uto0YYB2I5jLxKB9KGO59YD and comes back 401 every time.'

De klant schrijft: «In het logbestand staat deze regel: token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiI5MDcxMjg1NDAiLCJuYW1lIjoiU2FubmUgRG9vcm5ib3MiLCJlbWFpbCI6InMuZG9vcm5ib3NAZXhhbXBsZS5jb20iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODcwMDAwMDB9.68k5E41ldbdjlDfeTohH3mBiq5ZaIVd30pqu9TCUXtr – is dat erg? De commit 81e64da2c1a2e7b5038f65bf7469af9e31986852 staat er vlak boven.»
Der Kunde schreibt: «Im Fehlerprotokoll steht der vollständige Autorisierungsheader: Bearer wl-NBVtIN3XBb7MO2bx2Now3aBYWi9zDScSJrfSJjRyh. Die Anfrage-ID war 3212ea18-5518-4dad-855d-8689dbd777e6.»

Le client écrit : « Le jeton d'accès du service est eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcnYtOTQ3Mzg1IiwiYXVkIjoiYmlsbGluZyIsImlhdCI6MTc4NzAwMDAwMH0.a8f_zXXjDBGyHoiavFqqOvRUeYpo9hW-77PvAYfS7X6, et il figure tel quel dans le fichier de configuration versionné. »

Il cliente scrive: «Ho incollato il comando così com'è: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer DnC8KkP8q2FbuSia4q9oZtkJWC7IxGcrKgD47z9RFlvMeJHI8uAD' https://api.example.com/v1/tickets – funziona da riga di comando ma non dal server.»

The build log printed the artefact fingerprint UwJPV8fzzbMxhzjz3ty__eAK.DfafBDlyfmjrKImWa4l6sw_pE8a-w7ah.D8aKvDyKvwaJcTeacT2opNA5jmnfPdkEFd-vFsoQ7rl across three dotted segments, which is not a token of any kind.
The specification example shows an unsigned token, eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIn0. with an empty third segment, purely to illustrate the alg none case.
The bundler emitted vendor.runtime.chunk.min.js.map next to org.example.tooling.core in the same directory listing.
Bearer securities were withdrawn from circulation, and the bearer of the certificate may still present it at the counter for registration.
